wish: someone should make a tool that blacks out information in scanned documents
spec:
Opens a photo or scan of a page and lets you drag solid black boxes over anything you want gone.
Drag to cover an area, tap a box to remove it, tap empty space to drop a line-sized box, then Save PNG.
It does not open PDFs or read text; the saved PNG is new pixels only, so covered content and original metadata are not in it.

expect.matches: PNG ready: \d+ × \d+ px, 1 box burned in

notes: Images only (JPG/PNG/whatever the browser decodes); PDFs need to be exported as an image first since a PDF renderer would not fit the size budget. Very large scans are scaled to 16 MP to stay under phone canvas limits.
